messages:
maya: Heads-up — we got a request from compliance for an export that links audit events to canonical actor identities (email + org) while supporting pagination and streaming. How do we want to expose this from the API/console?
ryan: We currently have /audit/events and a small export endpoint but it returns NDJSON blobs and no actor resolution. We can either enrich on read (join w/ identity service) or attach actor refs and let downstream join.
olga: Enriching on read sounds convenient but expensive at scale. Exports can be huge (customer reported 150M events). We should support both: lightweight refs plus an optional "resolve_actors=true" query that does async enrichment and writes a resolved file.
samira: Also need PII modes: none, pseudonymize, redact. Compliance will ask for retention-aware exports (only include events within retention window).
elias: From infra side, streaming directly to S3 signed-url is preferred. Export job creates a manifest of chunked NDJSON files and returns presigned URLs + cursor. Pagination should work via cursor tokens — not offset.
maya: Proposal: POST /audit/exports with body { "query":..., "format":"ndjson|csv", "resolve_actors":"none|refs|resolved", "pii_mode":"none|pseudonymize|redact", "dest":"s3|webhook|console" } -> returns job_id + first_page_url.
ryan: If resolve_actors=resolved we should run enrichment with a best-effort map and include actor_resolution_status in metadata per-event (e.g., resolved|partial|unresolved). That will help telemetry.
olga: Agree. Also add sampling param? For huge customers they might request sample=0.01 to get 1% for quick checks. Sampling must be stable (seeded) to be useful.
samira: UX: in console, show approximate size, retention-applies notice, and a preview first 100 lines. For resolved actor exports show an actor mapping file separately so downstream teams can reconcile IDs.
elias: Quotas: exports should consume export-units, not normal token quotas. We need throttle + concurrency limits per-org. If large job hits limits, provide fallback background scheduling and status via GET /audit/exports/{job_id}.
infra-bot: deploy-bot: export-service v2 rolled out to canary (rg-a). No infra incidents.
maya: Edge-case: when identity service is down, resolved jobs should either fail fast or proceed with refs and mark unresolved. Which is preferred?
ryan: Prefer proceed with refs + mark unresolved + retry-enrich later. Will require a follow-up job to re-enrich; include re-enrich webhook callback option.
olga: For formats: CSV needs careful escaping for nested JSON in metadata. NDJSON remains default for fidelity. Add a --compress option (gzip).
samira: On console, add a small "create export" wizard: query builder, pii dropdown, actor resolution toggle, dest. Default to refs + redact for orgs without consent.
elias: Telemetry: emit metrics: export_requested, export_completed, export_failed, events_exported_count, unresolved_actor_count. Tag with org_id, job_type, pii_mode.
maya: Action items: 1) ryan + olga: draft API spec including pagination/cursor and job status contract. 2) elias: quota and storage cost calc per GB + concurrency policy. 3) samira + product: console mockups with preview + warnings. 4) infra: hook for presigned s3 manifest upload.
ryan: I'll sketch the OpenAPI paths and include example response payloads. Example job-response: 
```
POST /audit/exports -> 202 Accepted
{
  "job_id":"job_01F...",
  "status":"pending",
  "first_page_url":"/audit/exports/job_01F.../pages/1?cursor=abc",
  "manifest_url":"https://s3.amazonaws.com/.../manifest.json"
}
```
olga: Nice. Also make sure to include event-level metadata keys: event_ts, event_type, actor_ref, actor_resolution_status, actor_email_if_resolved, change_payload.
samira: Will schedule product sync next Tue. If anyone has privacy/legal concerns today ping me.
maya: Cool. I'll file a doc in the audit-specs folder and tag ppl. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
